prompts.top_surface: top surface of a LEGO brick

input: All18original1280x720JPEGs; each prompt independently; unchanged AimAssist Sam3Candidates processor-accepted outputs at its existing confidence threshold (.5 strict); before additional filtering/deduplication. Not unfiltered logits.

primary_matching.roi: Evaluate detections whose model-box center lies inside historical approximate stack ROI; outside separately reported.
primary_matching.one_to_one: Historical maximum-cardinality box-envelope IoU>=.50 then maximize IoU; scipy linear_sum_assignment(-1000*(IoU>=.5)-IoU).
primary_matching.merge: Detection covers>=.50 each of at least2positive face envelopes and contains their centers; ineligible individual match.
primary_matching.duplicate: Unmatched nonmerge model box IoU>=.50 with an already matched positive.
primary_matching.lower_fragment: Otherwise unmatched nonmerge boxcenter inside known lowerfragment polygon. Sparse conservative check only.
primary_matching.ambiguous: Otherwise unmatched nonmerge boxcenter in an ambiguous polygon ignored.
primary_matching.other: Remaining unmatched insideROI = other_spurious_or_unresolved, not all background hallucinations.
primary_matching.precision: Matches/(raw detections - outsideROI - ambiguousignored); merges/duplicates/unresolved are not individual true positives.

whole_stack_coarse.measurements: Best model-box ROI-envelopeIoU, highest-score box ROI-envelopeIoU and ROIcoverage; anyboxIoU>=.50 coarse localization count.
whole_stack_coarse.interpretation: Approximate ROI includes lattice gaps/table; no true whole-stack segmentation reference. Individual and whole-stack scores separate.

supplementary_masks.rasterization: Round frozen polygon vertices to nearest pixel, OpenCV fillPoly at original full image resolution.
supplementary_masks.matched_pairs: Mask/positive-facepolygon pixelIoU, referencecoverage, predictioncoverage on primary-box-matched pairs.
supplementary_masks.multiface: Every raw mask covering>=.50pixelarea of>=2positivefacepolygons, independently of box merge.
supplementary_masks.lower: Every raw mask covering>=.50pixelarea of a sparse lowerfragment: diagnostic flag not physical layer classification.
supplementary_masks.roi: Per-mask overlap/coverage with approximate ROI; not exact full-stack segmentation quality.

excluded_claims: No gripper accessibility, physical current-top height, calibrated metric pose, shade/quality classification, stud localization or automatic orientation claims.
No prompt pooling, prompt selection, manual prompts, mask repair, geometric refinement, retraining or simulation.
execution: All inference and batch pixel scoring through default Pueue, immutable code/config/reference snapshot; host existing unitree_sim_env evaluator runtime after container inference.
